creditCosts.name: OPERATION_COST_SQL
creditCosts.derivedFrom: sql<number>`COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ${generationOperations.chargedCredits} > 0 THEN ${generationOperations.chargedCredits} ELSE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(linked.pointsCost) FROM ${generations} AS linked WHERE linked.operationId = ${generationOperations}.id), 0) END), 0)`
